paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, Solomon in TOUPA' inn leh ama inn alam sung kum sawmnih abei in,
heading: Solomon Sepkhiak Dangte / (1 Kum 9.10-28)

paite: Huram in Solomon khopi apiakte Solomon in inn abawl a, Israel suante a-omsak hi.
Solomon in Hamath-zobah asual a, azou hi,
Gamdai ah, Tadmor abawl a, Hamath a vankoihna khuate toh.
Beth-horon saknungzaw leh khangnungzaw leng, kulhte, kongkhakte, akalhnate nei in abawlbeh hi.
Baalath khuate, avankoihna khua tengteng, akangtalai koihna khuate, asakol tungtuang mite omna khuate, Jerusalem leh Lebanon leh agamsung pumpi ah Solomon in adeih bangbang in abawl hi.
Israel suante hilou, Hitte, Amorte, Perizte, Hivte, Jebuste suan a om lai mite tengteng;
Israel suante'n ahihmanlouhte uh, huai gam a amaute nung a nutsiat a om asuante uh, tutan a, Solomon in sikha nasem ding a goih teitei pawl ding in abawl hi.
Israel suante Solomon in anasemmi sikha ding in abawl kei a, kidou mite, asepaih heutute makaite, akangtalai leh asakol tungtuangmi heutu ahi zaw uhi.
Huaite mipite heutu, Solomon makai lianpente ahi ua, zanih-le-sawmnga ahi uhi.
Solomon in David khopi a kipan atuam a inn alamsak ah Pharaoh tanu apitou a, "Ka zi Israel kumpipa David inn a om ding ahi kei, TOUPA bawm hong tunna mun siang ahi," achi hi.
Huchi in Solomon in inlim mai a TOUPA a ding a TOUPA maitam abawl tung ah halmang thillatte alan hi.

Mosi thupiak, niteng a dia bikhiah bangbang in Sabbath ni ah, kha thak ni, ankuanglui hun nei, kum khat a thumvei, Tanghou Silngou Soh Louh Ankuangluinate, Nipikal Ankuangluinate, Biakbuk Ankuangluinate,

Huan apa David na seh bang in siampu pawlte leh Levite atantuam chiat ua, niteng a sep kul dungzui zel a, phat dingte, siampute ma a nasem ding in asep a; kongkhak teng ah apawlpawl a veng mite asep lai a; huchibang in Pathian mipa David in ana sep hi.
Kumpipa'n siampute, Levite thu apiak bangchi mah in sumthute leng apialsan het kei uhi.
TOUPA' inn abawlkhiak tung ua kipan a azoh tan un, Solomon in asuktuahsa bang geih ahi. Huchi in TOUPA' inn pichin ahita hi.
Huchi in Solomon bel Edom gam a luipi gei a Ezion-geber ah leh Eloth ah ahoh a,
Huram in asikha tuipi a gamtangmi, longte toh akuansak a, Solomon sikhate toh Ophir ah ahoh ua, huai ah dangka-eng talent zali-le-sawmnga ahon pua ua, kumpipa Solomon kiang ah hon tun uhi.
